# Reader-round fixtures — 2026-09-25 `prome-2e` (copied verbatim from the session scratchpad at closeout 10:09 ET; ARGUS ❌5: a scratchpad path is tied to one session on one machine)

Ledgers and counterexample scripts from the seven independent reader rounds over `argus_scope.py` (WQ-289 rounds 3–5), `spawn_list.py` (L455 rounds 1–2) and `prome_gate.py` (L417 rounds 1–2). The scripts build THROWAWAY repos/dirs and never read the live tree; run them from the repo root with `python3 PROME/tools/tests/fixtures/2026-09-25_prome-2e_reader_rounds/<script>` (some expect `harness.py` beside them and a scratch directory they create). They are the fixtures the three `next-PROME-session` DOCKET residue rows name.
